_comment: Version-controlled register of site references that could not be tied to an approved CCCM master-site ID. One row per raw reference. A row exists ONLY to record evidence and ownership: it never asserts a match. To resolve a row, set official_site_id + match_method + confidence + approved_by + valid_from and change status to 'resolved'; the pipeline then treats it as an approved alias. Rows left 'unresolved' keep their assessments published_with_warning and excluded from matched-site coverage and mapping. Never fill official_site_id without evidence recorded in evidence[].

evidence: exact official site ID: no CCCM master-site ID equals this reference
approved alternate / legacy ID: absent from data/site-code-crosswalk.json (517 entries)
form choice list: code resolves to the site name 'Adhi Cadeeye' in district SO1401, with no catchment
exact normalized name within Laas Caanood: no match among the district's 26 approved master sites
nationwide name check: 'Adhi Cadeeye' does not appear in the master list under any district
coordinate-assisted matching: not possible, the submission carries no GPS point
conclusion: no trusted match exists; this is most likely an ACTED-identified site not yet registered through the Site ID Generator
entries.resolution_note: Requires CCCM master-site registration or an authoritative mapping from ACTED. Do not assign a master-site ID without one.
